title: Count Products per Category
description:
Count how many products belong to each category in the catalog.

**Table: products** — `id`, `name`, `category`, `price`

Return `category` and `product_count`. Order by `category`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INT, name VARCHAR, category VARCHAR, price DECIMAL(10,2)); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Widget A','Electronics',25.00),(2,'Widget B','Electronics',40.00),(3,'Widget C','Electronics',35.00),(4,'Chair','Furniture',199.00),(5,'Desk','Furniture',299.00),(6,'Lamp','Furniture',49.00),(7,'Shirt','Clothing',29.99),(8,'Pants','Clothing',49.99),(9,'Hat','Clothing',19.99);
solution_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

test_cases.description: 3 categories (Clothing, Electronics, Furniture), each with 3 products

hints: GROUP BY category creates one output row per unique category value.
COUNT(*) counts the rows in each category group.
explanation: GROUP BY category partitions the 9 product rows into three groups: Clothing (3 products), Electronics (3), and Furniture (3). COUNT(*) returns the size of each group.
